extension.description: Browse movies and TV episodes in TMDBHelper and select a Usenet release in Kodi. NeNeTeePee-Stream-Kodi supports nzbdav / InfiniDysk streaming, NZBGet completed-file playback, and StreamNZB direct streaming. Includes release parsing, configurable filters, and sorting.
